title: lomatium graveolens
intro: Lomatium graveolens, commonly known as Western Lomatium or Fern-leaved Biscuitroot, is a perennial plant native to the dry regions of the Pacific Northwest in North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as colds and flu. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its antimicrobial, antiviral, and expectorant properties, which help to fight off infections and clear congestion. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium graveolens include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
